## Final Accepted Amendments

### `fr-5-ceb38e20`

In `crates/tank_core/src/types/actions.rs:78-80`, the `SchemaVersionTooOld` error message says "save file version {actual} is too old; minimum supported version is {min_supported}" but unlike `SchemaVersionTooNew` (which suggests "upgrade the application"), it gives no remediation guidance. Consider adding actionable text like "re-create this save with a newer version of the application" so users know what to do when they encounter a v1 save.

### `fr-5-b65ff026`

Make `crates/tank_core/tests/shrimp_population.rs:111-155` fully deterministic instead of relying on a lucky RNG draw. In the current setup, `hatch_success_base = 1.0` is still multiplied by condition, oxygen, temperature, stability, and mineral factors in `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:420-447`, so the assertion only passes because seed `7100` happens to satisfy `rng.next_f64() < p_hatch`. Force `p_hatch` to 1.0 (or exercise a deterministic helper/path) so unrelated changes to RNG consumption or chemistry tuning do not randomly break this test.
